integrate.why_skipped: audit job did not succeed, so the integrate job is skipped by the workflow condition

mechanism.claim: The 'Independent audit' agent step succeeded and the audit job then died at 'Enforce audit scope and read gate'. The public check-run annotation reads 'auditor crossed scope:' and the runner reports exit code 3; the per-path list is not exposed in the public annotation and job logs are not downloadable here. The 'Persist audit snapshot' step was skipped, so no audit ref and no gate exist for this run. This is an auditor WRITE-SCOPE failure, not a product rejection and not a verdict. No provider, auth or work-quantum cause is asserted.

adjudication.control_plane_attention: the independent-audit agent finished, but the workflow's gate-reader step rejected the audit workspace because at least one path was written outside results/audit/<lane>/ and reports/audit/<lane>/ (annotation 'auditor crossed scope:', runner exit code 3). The gate-reader never read a gate, the persist step was skipped, and no audit ref exists. .github/** belongs to the control plane and is recorded, never edited from a lane. The product-side route-around is product/audit_scope_guard.py: the auditor can run it after writing its two artifacts and remove every listed path before the workflow's own check.
adjudication.next_action: Re-run the independent audit from this persisted snapshot and write ONLY results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json and reports/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run>.md; run product/audit_scope_guard.py --scope audit before handing off. Do not infer a REVISE, a BLOCKED verdict or a product regression from the auditor's scope failure.

orchestration.claim_ceiling: This artifact classifies an orchestration failure from a public run/jobs snapshot. It asserts no cause it could not observe, writes no audit gate, treats no run as accepted or rejected, and makes no product, legal or serve claim.

durable_delta.meaning: the team ref carries a committed delta over its predecessor; the snapshot can be resumed and audited on its own bytes

accepted_head_relation.resume_action: The snapshot diverges from the accepted head; verify the durable delta, finish the lane deliverable and make it audit-ready.

adjudication.why_not_accepted: requirement 4 needs BOTH an independent PASS gate on the audit ref AND an accept commit on lab/product; at least one half is absent for this run

runtime_preflight.workflow_gap: no step of .github/workflows/core-lane.yml installs product/requirements-query.txt, so a fresh runner has none of these; recorded as a control-plane item, never edited from this lane

fresh_runner_no_site_probe.meaning: python -S skips the user site used by bootstrap_query_env.sh; missing modules here are the fresh-runner validation gap, not a product defect

validation_findings.meaning: These are reproducible validation gaps, not a provider/auth mechanism and not a product verdict. Missing deps and a missing claimed test make a green snapshot fail its own self-check on a fresh runner; they are repaired by the resuming cycle, never by weakening a frozen bar.

claim_ceiling: This artifact classifies an orchestration outcome and a git-ref delta. It writes no gate, labels no run accepted or rejected, asserts no cause the committed run/jobs snapshot cannot show, and makes no product, legal or serve claim.
